# Incident Response Standard

Revision: v07. Effective: 2024-12-20. Owner: Head of Information Security.

## 1. Purpose

This document sets the minimum requirements for incident response. It exists so that each team applies the same
rules the same way, and so that an auditor can check that they do.

## 2. Scope

This document applies to each employee, contractor and system of the company. Where a contract or a law imposes a stricter
requirement, the stricter requirement applies.

## 3. Definitions

- In-scope systems: each system listed in the asset register with this policy as its control set.
- Owner: the role accountable for this document and for approving exceptions to it.
- Confirmed event: an event that the response team has classified, as opposed to a report.
- Working day: Monday to Friday excluding public holidays at the registered office.

## 4. Requirements

- **R1.** Requests under this policy are approved or declined within 10 working days of submission.
- **R2.** Exceptions to this policy are approved in writing by the document owner and recorded in the exception register.
- **R3.** Encryption in transit uses current, non-deprecated protocol versions only.
- **R4.** Test and development environments never hold production data unless it has been anonymised.
- **R5.** Interactive sessions expire after 24 hours and require re-authentication.
- **R6.** Records covered by this policy are retained for 365 days from the date of their creation and then deleted.
- **R7.** Backups of in-scope systems run at least each 6 hours and are tested quarterly.
- **R9.** Third parties handling in-scope data are bound by a written agreement that imposes equivalent requirements.

## 5. Exceptions

Exceptions are granted only where a requirement cannot be met for technical or legal reasons, are
time-limited, and are reviewed at each scheduled review of this document.

## 6. Review and ownership

The owner of this document is the Head of Information Security, who approves exceptions and signs off each revision.
Material changes are communicated to all affected teams before they take effect.
